text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool. It copies tables from a Postgres database to Amazon S3. It writes the data as Parquet files. You can use it for backups, for analytics, or to move data between systems.

To start a sync, give sqlpipe the database connection, the list of tables, and the target S3 bucket. sqlpipe reads each table in batches and writes one or more Parquet files for each table. You can run a full copy, or you can copy only the rows that changed after a given time. If a sync stops before it is complete, you can start it again. sqlpipe will continue from the last batch that it wrote.
